comparison.objective: Slide a skid under a machine while raising the machine no more than 30 mm.
comparison.physical_skill: Constrained heavy-object lifting and insertion into a narrow clearance.
comparison.success_condition: Skid is positioned beneath the machine without exceeding the 30 mm lift limit; other rubric details are absent.
comparison.reason: This is clearance-limited load support and sliding insertion, unrelated to hammer-driven notch fracture and containment of released tangs.
